source.note: Primary readable source giving a full default keybind table for both keyboard and Xbox controller (Move/Aim=Left Stick+D-Pad, Jump=A/Y, Dash=X/B, Talk=B, Grab&Climb=LT/RT/LB/RB). Cross-checked against multiple independent Steam Community and search summaries (e.g. steamcommunity.com/app/504230 discussions) which stated the same Jump=A/Y, Dash=X/B, Grab=all four shoulder buttons mapping, and against keyboard defaults (Arrow Keys move, C=Jump/Confirm, X=Dash/Cancel, Z/V/LeftShift=Grab, Escape=Pause, Tab=Journal, R=Quick Restart) found via Steam Community and search results. Direct access to PCGamingWiki, Neoseeker, and the official celeste.ink wiki was blocked (403/Cloudflare) despite repeated attempts including a reader-proxy fallback, so those could not be used to independently verify the menu-navigation buttons (Pause/Confirm/Cancel/Journal) on controller, which are listed under 'disputed'.
source.method: read from the web by agent/research.py

confidence: researched, not checked by a person

X.action: Dash (and aim the dash with the stick/d-pad)

B.action: Dash (alternate button); also used to talk to NPCs

disputed.start: Likely bound to Pause by default (standard Xbox convention) but no source I could read explicitly confirmed the default controller Pause binding; only keyboard Escape was confirmed.
disputed.back: Possibly used for Journal by default on controller, but no source explicitly stated this; keyboard default for Journal is Tab.
disputed.guide: No source confirmed a default binding for Confirm/Cancel/Journal on the controller specifically (as opposed to reusing Jump/Dash buttons); sources only stated keyboard Confirm=C, Cancel=X and inferred but did not verify the controller equivalents (A/B or A/X).
disputed.left_trigger+right_trigger+start: Pre-1.4 patch versions had a hardcoded Quick Restart shortcut of holding both bumpers/triggers plus Start on gamepad; this was removed in patch 1.4 in favor of a user-assignable Quick Restart bind with no default, so current default behavior for a dedicated Quick Restart button is unclear/unconfirmed.
